title: Speaking Without Words: A Meta-Analysis of Over 70 Years of Research on the Power of Nonverbal Cues in Job Interviews
metricDefinition: The abstract treats dynamic and static nonverbal cues as broad evidence categories and discusses interview-context moderators.

measurements.definition: Broad dynamic and static cue categories synthesized across prior interview studies.
notes: Category-level effects are not Face-Fit metric definitions.

reportedFindings.summary: The abstract supports nonverbal behavior as interview context while emphasizing modality, structure, duration, and other moderators.

thresholdAssessment.reason: Meta-analytic associations across heterogeneous cue definitions do not specify operational Face-Fit boundaries.

limitations: Only the official abstract was reviewed.
Heterogeneous cues and study moderators prevent direct metric or threshold transfer.
